visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde-highlighted hair and a green stone necklace sits in a rustic tavern. She smiles broadly and gestures toward two large plates of food featuring potatoes and ham on bread, with a pint of beer and a mojito beside them. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban street where the woman wears sunglasses and waves enthusiastically at the camera. She points toward a red shop sign on a stone building while passers-by move in the background under natural daylight. (3) She enters the crowded bar, waving to the camera. The interior features wooden beams and brick walls. A male bartender in a black shirt is seen behind a counter preparing a drink with ice and mint leaves. (4) The woman returns to her seat, holding two overflowing plates of fried food and tapas. She performs a small dance of excitement at the table, showing off the meal. The lighting is warm and indoor. (5) Close-up shots show the woman biting into a hot potato and reacting to the temperature with wide eyes. Later, she is joined by another female companion; they toast their glasses and drink together while laughing in the busy restaurant environment.
